description: Unit test class for HiveMqtt3ClientActor, testing MQTT client actor behavior including connection, subscription, and message handling using mocks and Akka testkit.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3ClientActorTest
classes.description: Test suite for HiveMqtt3ClientActor, including setup, connection failures, message sending, and payload extraction.

methods.name: initClient
methods.description: Initializes the MQTT client mock and factory before each test to optimize setup.

methods.name: expectDisconnectCalled
methods.description: Verifies that disconnect was called on the mock client factory.

methods.name: testSubscribeFails
methods.description: Tests the behavior when subscription to MQTT topic fails, expecting a failure message.

methods.name: createClientActor
methods.description: Creates Props for HiveMqtt3ClientActor with a given connection and proxies.

methods.name: createFailingClientActor
methods.description: Creates Props for a failing HiveMqtt3ClientFactory simulating connection failure.

methods.name: createClientActorWithMessages
methods.description: Creates Props for HiveMqtt3ClientActor with predefined messages for testing message handling.

methods.name: mqttMessage
methods.description: Constructs an MQTT publish message with specified topic and payload.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts and decodes the payload from an Mqtt3Publish message.

methods.name: extractTopic
methods.description: Extracts the topic string from an Mqtt3Publish message.

methods.name: getMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the MQTT message handled, which is Mqtt3Publish.
